runs.failure_point: It never opened the matter with the nine-month settlement covenant, although its own file-name search listed it, and answered with a 12-month separation agreement from another matter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The unopened-matters list appended to the reviews at [43], [58] and [70] named the matter among about 30; the review texts flagged unopened matters only generically, and the agent never opened it.
first_error.why: The matter with the nine-month settlement covenant appeared in its saved file-name list at [35], but when choosing what to read it picked ten agreements from eight other matters and never opened that matter, so the answer settles on a 12-month term.

divergence: Mixed (T0 passes; T1 and T2 fail). All runs listed the store, searched file names and scanned document text for covenant language. T2 split off at screening: its file-name list showed the matter with the nine-month settlement covenant, but it read agreements from eight other matters and answered with a 12-month separation agreement; the reviews flagged unopened matters only generically, and the matter was named only in the appended unopened-matters list. T0 and T1 both found the nine-month term through duration scans and agent-defined verification stages (the reviewer suggested both of T0's and one of T1's). They split at the write stage: T0 gave the nine-month term as the answer with the 12-month agreement as a comparator; T1 made the nine-month answer conditional and named the 12-month agreement as the shortest standalone term. No review flagged that wording; T1's check review recommended it.
